inlines.v: NI'TROUS, adjective Pertaining to niter; partaking of the qualities of niter, or resembling it. nitrous acid is one of the compounds formed of nitrogen and oxygen, in which the oxygen is in a lower proportion than that in which the same elements form nitric acid.
